phase1_initial_proposals.technology_specification: Digital Signal Processor (DSP) integrated circuit (IC) used in high-performance audio and communication systems.

It handles tasks like real-time audio filtering, echo cancellation, and speech recognition. Given its computational demands and specialized design, it forms a distinct subassembly with a unique supply chain and is often procured as a complete unit.
